thought.text: Both download URLs work. Now let me install Ruby 3.4.10 (building in background) and Node.js 24.9.0 in parallel.

reasoning_content:
Both URLs are reachable. Now, install Ruby 3.4.10 from source (in the background, it takes about 3–5 minutes) and Node.js 24.9.0 in parallel.

Start the Ruby build in the background, and while that's running, install Node.js.

action.command:
mkdir -p /opt/downloads /opt/tools && cd /opt/downloads && nohup sh -c 'curl -sSL -o ruby-3.4.10.tar.xz https://cache.ruby-lang.org/pub/ruby/3.4/ruby-3.4.10.tar.xz && tar xf ruby-3.4.10.tar.xz && cd ruby-3.4.10 && ./configure --prefix=/opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10 --with-openssl-dir=/usr >/tmp/ruby_configure.log 2>&1 && make -j"$(nproc)" >/tmp/ruby_make.log 2>&1 && make install >>/tmp/ruby_make.log 2>&1 && echo RUBY_BUILD_OK > /tmp/ruby_build.done' >/dev/null 2>&1 &
echo "ruby build started in background, pid $!"

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "mkdir -p /opt/downloads /opt/tools && cd /opt/downloads && nohup sh -c 'curl -sSL -o ruby-3.4.10.tar.xz https://cache.ruby-lang.org/pub/ruby/3.4/ruby-3.4.10.tar.xz && tar xf ruby-3.4.10.tar.xz && cd ruby-3.4.10 && ./configure --prefix=/opt/tools/ruby-3.4.10 --with-openssl-dir=/usr >/tmp/ruby_configure.log 2>&1 && make -j\"$(nproc)\" >/tmp/ruby_make.log 2>&1 && make install >>/tmp/ruby_make.log 2>&1 && echo RUBY_BUILD_OK > /tmp/ruby_build.done' >/dev/null 2>&1 &\necho \"ruby build started in background, pid $!\"", "summary": "Start Ruby 3.4.10 build in background", "security_risk": "HIGH"}
